barriers.title: Eligibility is confusing
barriers.tagline: Break complex government/corporate criteria into a simple yes/no personal checklist.
barriers.description: Legalese and complex percentiles make you wonder if you qualify. Let's verify every condition line-by-line so you never miss out on self-doubt.

barriers.title: I don't know which documents are needed
barriers.tagline: Get an exact document prep roadmap with issuing offices, DigiLocker shortcuts, and file guidelines.
barriers.description: Don't get disqualified by missing certificates. See the exact paperwork needed, where to obtain it, and track what you've collected.

barriers.title: I discovered it late
barriers.tagline: Triage your application with a fast-track MVP submission checklist and cycle reminders.
barriers.description: Deadline in a few days? Don't panic. Focus strictly on minimum viable submission tasks and set automated alerts for future cycles.

barriers.title: I have limited internet or device access
barriers.tagline: Download a 100% offline printable text guide and use the 15-minute Cyber-Café battle plan.
barriers.description: Spotty Wi-Fi, low mobile data, or sharing a phone? Draft everything offline on paper/phone, then upload in one quick 15-minute session.

barriers.title: I don't know how to start
barriers.tagline: Overcome the blank page with a 3-phase micro-roadmap and ready-to-use essay templates.
barriers.description: Big application portals feel intimidating. We break the entire process into zero-pressure 10-minute micro-steps with starter drafts.

barriers.title: I have limited time
barriers.tagline: Time-box your application into four 10-to-15 minute micro-sprints with a built-in focus timer.
barriers.description: Juggling college classes, exams, or family work? Complete your application in small 10-minute bursts over 3 days without burning out.

common_guidance.trust_notice: EduBridge AI helps you organize your application steps. We never guarantee selection or eligibility. Always confirm final requirements on the official provider portal.
common_guidance.privacy_promise: All data stays stored inside your browser localStorage. No sensitive Aadhaar or bank information is ever requested or transmitted.
